summary: Roadmap 1.21 waveform workflow simplification: Reanalyze Track replaces Refresh Waveform Only; locked cue markers and approval history are preserved; long or invalid-duration Tracks queue through the existing analyzer; incomplete stereo caches are rejected and results distinguish displayable from verified. Routine cue-marker events are hidden from Monitoring Recent Events without deleting records. Restart Gunicorn only; no migration, static, unit, package, nginx or protected-runtime change.
